series: AI Systems That Survive Contact With Operations
title: Your AI Agent Passed the Demo. Now Break It.
audience: Founders, operators and automation owners preparing live agent deployments
hypothesis: A three-test failure rehearsal provides a distinct implementation payoff and more qualified viewer discussion than generic AI safety advice
visual_concept: Ten original illustrated test scenes: permission denial, stale source evidence and emergency stop
cta: Which failure test would your workflow fail?
planned_publish_time: Only after full editorial sign-off and rechecking the sole target channel; at least 4 hours from any other Short

success_thresholds.at_72h: Provisional >=50 organic views, >=60% average percentage viewed, >=1 substantive comment; replace with channel-relative benchmarks when reliable per-video data exists
success_thresholds.at_7d: Subscriber conversion and qualified comments; no paid reach

source_claims: Original hypothetical test scenarios, not a real incident or certification

qa.audio: offline FFmpeg flite voice, synthetic narration
qa.visuals: 10 original illustrated scenes, no stock footage
qa.version: v3 corrected safety response and burned captions
qa.editorial_correction: If a test fails, stop the agent. Investigate and retest before restoring access. Visual holds READ, DRAFT, PAY.
